en: A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a valley surrounded by rolling fields and wooded hills. In the foreground and mid‑ground are compact rows of traditional houses with pitched roofs. A large, prominent institutional building stands slightly above the town; above it, the printed caption 'Volksschule.' identifies it as a public school. At the bottom of the image, printed in red, is the caption 'Glashütte i. S.' along with the publisher information '6919 Brück & Sohn, Meissen'.
